text:
emily: quick idea  'Build-in-a-Week' micro-launch for devs: 3 tutorials + one tiny refapp + mentor webinar. want landing post, tutorials, refapp repo, webinar funnel, inbound routing.

rahul: sounds good. i can adapt the tiny-refapp starter and add a minimal Docker quickstart. ETA Tue.

maria: i'll write the tutorials (3 x ~20m labs). goal: reproducible prompts + a short bench note. drafts by Fri.

kevin: i'll own the webinar funnel and registration. propose: gated form, UTMs, auto-add to nurture list.

emily: inbound routing: route active attendees to solutions-eng if they click "talk to an engineer" or complete >60% labs. tag leads with 'biw_interest'.

kevin: metrics: signups, attendance rate, lab completions, refapp stars, MQLs. put dashboards in HubSpot + Amplitude.

maria: content files i'll push:
```
/tutorials/biw/lab1-hello-refapp.md
/tutorials/biw/lab2-batching-and-cache.md
/tutorials/biw/lab3-deploy-patterns.md
/refapps/biw/README.md
/benchmarks/biw-demo-blurb.md
```

rahul: license MIT, add CONTRIBUTING.md for mentors. also will include a tiny benchmark script `bench.sh`.

emily: marketing-bot create review task for launch copy next Wed.

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/5099 assigned to @emily @kevin @maria. review due Wed 09:00 PT.

kevin: timeline recap: repo Tue, tutorials Fri, post review Wed, publish Thu, webinar 2 weeks after publish. sync Tue 11:00 PT.

emily: thanks team  TL;DR: assemble refapp + tutorial drafts this week, landing + emails by Fri, publish next Thu, webinar 2w later. :rocket:
